description: A sample TypeScript module containing user management functionality and utility functions for discount calculations

elements.name: User
elements.description: Defines the structure of a user entity with basic identification and contact information
elements.example: const user: User = { id: 1, name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' };

elements.name: UserService
elements.description: A service class that manages user operations including retrieval and creation of user entities
elements.example:
const userService = new UserService();
const user = await userService.createUser('Jane Doe', 'jane@example.com');
elements.warnings: Uses Date.now() for ID generation which may not be suitable for production use due to potential collisions

elements.name: getUser
elements.description: Retrieves a user by their unique identifier from the internal users array

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve

returns.description: A promise that resolves to the User object if found, otherwise undefined

elements.example:
const userService = new UserService();
const user = await userService.getUser(123);

elements.name: createUser
elements.description: Creates a new user with the provided name and email, automatically generating a unique ID
elements.signature: async createUser(name: string, email: string): Promise<User>

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The full name of the user to create

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address of the user to create

returns.description: A promise that resolves to the newly created User object

elements.example:
const userService = new UserService();
const newUser = await userService.createUser('Alice Smith', 'alice@example.com');
elements.warnings: Uses Date.now() for ID generation which may cause collisions if called rapidly

elements.name: calculateDiscount
elements.description: Calculates the discounted price by applying a discount rate to the original price
elements.signature: export function calculateDiscount(price: number, rate: number): number

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: The discount rate as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.1 for 10% discount)

returns.description: The final price after applying the discount

elements.warnings: Throws Error if rate is not between 0 and 1
